product: ai_forecast version 2 is now generally available
tagline: Version 2 of the ai forecast function is now generally available in Databricks SQL.
what_it_does: Version 2 of the ai forecast function is now generally available in Databricks SQL. A research optimized time series foundation model powers version 2 for improved out of the box accuracy, and version 2 adds built in holiday support, external covariates, and non negative forecasts. Applies to: Databricks SQL ai forecast() is a table valued function that extrapolates time series data forward in time.
why_it_matters: A research optimized time series foundation model powers version 2 for improved out of the box accuracy, and version 2 adds built in holiday support, external covariates, and non negative forecasts.
